title: PHP 5.6 to PHP 8.2 in one weekend: the realistic version
lede: The Loom landed at 23:41 on a Friday. Forty-eight hours to take a 14-year-old PHP codebase from 5.6 to 8.2. Here is the actual order it broke in.
